summary.headline: Luminaries and Lords of the Year
summary.text: Chapters VII and VIII of Māshāʾallāh’s astrology treatise discuss the luminaries in the angles, lords of the year, diurnal and nocturnal stars, annual revolutions, and the transfer of year-lordship to another planet through house placement, conjunction, and aspects.
